rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Seline is a cookieless, privacy-first analytics platform offering website traffic analysis, individual visitor journeys, conversion funnels, and revenue attribution. The MCP server connects to the Seline API to query analytics data, retrieve visit metrics, track custom events, and access top visitor statistics. Supports Stripe integration for revenue tracking and provides user-centric product analytics with profile identification and churn detection.
